scope: Native stored-render query, recovery and UI changes; read-only review without Cargo

findings.issue: Previous-session retained workflow exposed as current
findings.resolution: Filter current_render by project/session and clear session UI state

findings.issue: Raw IME confirmation can activate egui modal buttons
findings.resolution: Preserve IME events and suppress composition-owned Enter/Space/Escape before widgets
findings.evidence: Preedit+Enter and Commit+Space on a focused recovery button

findings.resolution: Retain entry focus across the suspended browser and restore on the next outer frame after Close
findings.evidence: Cancelled picker plus Tab/Escape asserts actual pane focus

findings.issue: Session cleanup hides a coalesced new-session render
findings.resolution: Clean up before comparing the incoming current-session workflow
findings.evidence: Real owner close/open/start while UI updates are held, followed by publication

replay_findings.issue: Tab reaches an action outside its paint clip
replay_findings.resolution: Immediately scroll focused actions into view and bound body height using measured header

replay_findings.issue: Immediate focus restore is lost to the current modal frame
replay_findings.evidence: Fourth production replay passes exact focus assertion

final_followup: No actionable findings in deferred focus restoration, modal discard handling, command-entry focus, session invalidation and nonmodal current-render status
remaining_native_observation: Native AX omitted the custom history overlay while the harness AccessKit tree contained it. Native keyboard and screenshot checks passed. VoiceOver acceptance remains open.
